summary: The US completed a heavy wave of strikes on Iran in response to ballistic missile attacks, hitting targets including command centers, missile facilities, and Iran's Ministry of Intelligence in Ahvaz. Iran fired missiles at Jordan targeting US bases at Al-Azraq, while the IDF destroyed Hezbollah's tunnel system under Beaufort Ridge in southern Lebanon using 700 tons of explosives. Israel-Hamas disarmament negotiations are advancing toward a signing ceremony in Egypt within days.
key_points: The US military completed a heavy wave of strikes on Iran targeting command centers, missile and drone facilities, border surveillance, and maritime capabilities in response to Iran's missile attacks on American forces (Source: @almogboker78/17852).

The IDF used 700 tons of explosives to destroy Hezbollah's tunnel system beneath Beaufort Ridge in southern Lebanon, following Hezbollah's violation of the ceasefire by targeting an unmanned bulldozer with an explosive drone (Source: @manniefabian/58897).

The IRGC launched ballistic missiles at Jordan, claiming to have destroyed three F-35s at the Al-Azraq air base, while Jordan's military reported intercepting five ballistic missiles (Source: @VahidOnline/77645).

Hamas and Palestinian militant groups agreed to all articles of the Trump plan for Gaza, with a formal announcement of the second-phase ceasefire expected after Israel agrees, and a signing ceremony in Egypt possible within days (Source: @New_security8200/203102).
The IDF attacked the Nabatieh area in southern Lebanon near the Mustafa R'ando hospital for a second time (Source: @yediotnews25/133433).

Iran fired missiles into the Strait of Hormuz, while the UK PM told Oman that London is ready to participate in a military mission to reopen the strait (Source: @lelotsenzura/93972, @SharghDaily/175341).
US satellite imagery confirmed strikes on Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and National Security provincial office in Ahvaz, Hormozgan Province (Source: @shin_persian/8734).

sections.executive_summary: The US completed a heavy wave of strikes on Iran targeting command centers, missile and drone facilities, border surveillance, and maritime capabilities in response to Iran's missile attacks on American forces. The IDF destroyed Hezbollah's tunnel system under Beaufort Ridge in southern Lebanon using 700 tons of explosives after Hezbollah violated the ceasefire by attacking an unmanned bulldozer with an explosive drone. Israel-Hamas disarmament negotiations are advancing toward a signing ceremony in Egypt within days, with Hamas agreeing to all articles of the Trump plan for Gaza.
iran: Iran fired projectiles into the Strait of Hormuz, escalating tensions in a critical global maritime chokepoint (Source: @lelotsenzura/93972).
American missiles struck Abadan in southern Iran, according to unverified security reports from the region (Source: @lelotsenzura/93976).
The IRGC Ground Force's Madineh Monawreh Headquarters at the Shahid Rudaki site on Qeshm Island, Hormozgan Province, Iran, was reportedly struck (Source: @shin_persian/8727).

Satellite imagery confirmed US overnight strikes on the Provincial Office of Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and National Security in Ahvaz, Iran, at coordinates 31.30171, 48.63548 (Source: @shin_persian/8734).

The US completed a heavy wave of strikes on Iran targeting military command centers, missile and unmanned aerial vehicle facilities, border surveillance and defense sites, and maritime capabilities (Source: @almogboker78/17852).

Iran's Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi warned that all parties must remain vigilant against Israeli plots and false-flag operations designed to undermine regional peace (Source: @presstv/200949).
The IRGC launched ballistic missiles at Jordan, claiming the strikes targeted US military bases in the country (Source: @VahidOnline/77642).
israel: The IDF destroyed Hezbollah's subterranean tunnel system beneath Beaufort Ridge in southern Lebanon using 700 tons of explosives, a operation postponed from an earlier date due to the ceasefire (Source: @manniefabian/58897).

The Israeli Air Force bombed four Hamas weapon depots across the Gaza Strip overnight, destroying assault rifles, explosive devices, anti-tank missile launchers, and other equipment stored by Hamas (Source: @manniefabian/58895).
The IDF attacked the city of Nabatieh in southern Lebanon a second time, near the Mustafa R'ando hospital (Source: @yediotnews25/133433).

Heavy explosions were expected overnight at the northern border in the Ramim Ridge, Hola Valley, and northern Golan areas due to IDF activity in Lebanon, with residents of Metula and Misgav Am asked to open windows in their homes (Source: @pkpoi/143487).
Prime Minister Netanyahu returned to Israel from the United States, landing at the Nevatim base for security reasons (Source: @amitesgal/63522).

The IDF began releasing reserve forces from the Gaza envelope, specifically from communities within 4 to 7 kilometers of the Gaza border, leaving only the ongoing security coordinator in each settlement (Source: @pkpoi/143485).

Soldiers in the Givati Brigade's Tzabar Battalion left their base at Shachar 10 after their battalion commander removed symbols associated with normative events, an incident the IDF Spokesperson said is being investigated (Source: @New_security8200/203086).
gaza_west_bank: Hamas agreed to all articles of the Trump plan for the Gaza Strip, with a formal announcement of the second-phase ceasefire to follow Israeli agreement on the plan's terms (Source: @New_security8200/203102).

Advanced talks are underway for Hamas to announce its disarmament and relinquish control of Gaza to an international stabilization force, with a signing ceremony possible in Egypt within days (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5937).

Under the emerging agreement, all combat materials in the Gaza Strip would be stored under the supervision of the technocrat government for the Strip, with a committee working with Hamas on weapon restriction and storage over a two-week period (Source: @yediotnews25/133440).

The IDF and Shin Bet completed a joint operation in Beit Ommar in the Hebron district, scanning over 170 locations, arresting wanted individuals, and finding weapons of various types (Source: @idf_telegram/24769).

IDF forces in the Hebron district shot and neutralized a terrorist who drove a vehicle toward an IDF force and did not respond to calls to stop, with no casualties to IDF forces (Source: @New_security8200/203097).

The IDF bombed four Hamas weapon depots across the Gaza Strip overnight, destroying assault rifles, explosive devices, anti-tank missile launchers, and other equipment intended for attacks on Israeli troops and civilians (Source: @manniefabian/58895).

The overall Israel-Hamas agreement process is expected to take between six and eight months, with IDF withdrawal beginning upon signing, and Hamas's heavy weapons to be transferred to the national committee for managing the Strip (Source: @yediotnews25/133440).
lebanon: The IDF destroyed Hezbollah's tunnel system beneath Beaufort Ridge in southern Lebanon using 700 tons of explosives (Source: @manniefabian/58897).
The IDF attacked the city of Nabatieh in southern Lebanon near the Mustafa R'ando hospital for a second time (Source: @yediotnews25/133433).
Heavy explosions were expected overnight at the northern border in the Ramim Ridge, Hola Valley, and northern Golan areas due to IDF military activity in Lebanon (Source: @pkpoi/143487).

Hezbollah violated the ceasefire agreement by targeting an unmanned bulldozer with an explosive drone, prompting the IDF's demolition of the Beaufort Ridge tunnel system (Source: @manniefabian/58897).
Artillery shelling was reported in the Mansouri area of southern Lebanon, with a live map provided for further details (Source: @redlinkleb/33968).
syria_iraq: Iraq's government spokesperson denied that Iraq had any prior knowledge of the US-Saudi strikes conducted on Iraqi soil (Source: @SharghDaily/175349).
Iraq's Foreign Ministry spokesperson confirmed that Iraq did not authorize the US and Saudi strikes and had no prior information about them (Source: @asafroz/52108).
The US Embassy in Baghdad issued instructions restricting the movement of its staff (Source: @naya_foriraq/86425).
The UN Deputy Spokesperson warned about the humanitarian consequences of escalating tensions in the West Asia (Middle East) region and the worsening of conditions (Source: @SharghDaily/175348).

Egypt's Minister of Media for the Arabiya channel disputed the Wall Street Journal's claim that Egypt held Iran responsible for the recent attack on two tankers in the port of Damietta (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382128).
gulf_states: Jordan's military reported intercepting five ballistic missiles fired from Iran toward the country on Thursday, Mordad 8 (Source: @VahidOnline/77642).
The IRGC claimed to have destroyed three F-35 fighter jets and caused heavy damage to three others at the Al-Azraq air base in Jordan using ballistic missiles (Source: @VahidOnline/77645).
Pakistan helped Iran escort at least one Qatari LNG tanker, the Al-Areesh, safely through the Strait of Hormuz, alleviating Pakistan's worsening energy shortage (Source: @SharghDaily/175342).
France's Foreign Ministry stated that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz affects the world's economy (Source: @naya_foriraq/86421).

UK Prime Minister Andrew Starmer told Oman's Sultan Haitham bin Tarik that London is ready to participate in a military mission to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after a ceasefire is established (Source: @SharghDaily/175341).
The Wall Street Journal reported that Egyptian officials held Iran responsible for the recent attack on two tankers in the port of Damietta, Egypt (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78294).
key_developments: The US completed a heavy wave of strikes on Iran targeting military command centers, missile and drone facilities, border surveillance, and maritime capabilities in direct response to Iran's ballistic missile attacks on American forces (Source: @almogboker78/17852).

The IDF used 700 tons of explosives to destroy Hezbollah's entire tunnel system beneath Beaufort Ridge in southern Lebanon, following Hezbollah's ceasefire violation of targeting an unmanned bulldozer with an explosive drone (Source: @manniefabian/58897).

The IRGC launched ballistic missiles at Jordan claiming to have destroyed three F-35s at the Al-Azraq air base, while Jordan's military reported intercepting five missiles (Source: @VahidOnline/77645).

Hamas agreed to all articles of the Trump plan for Gaza, with a second-phase ceasefire signing ceremony possible in Egypt within days and a process expected to last 6 to 8 months (Source: @New_security8200/203102).
US satellite imagery confirmed strikes on Iran's Ministry of Intelligence provincial office in Ahvaz at coordinates 31.30171, 48.63548, as part of the overnight campaign (Source: @shin_persian/8734).

The IDF attacked the Nabatieh area in southern Lebanon near the Mustafa R'ando hospital for a second time, while heavy explosions were expected overnight at the northern border near Ramim Ridge and the Golan (Source: @yediotnews25/133433, @pkpoi/143487).
Iraq denied any prior knowledge of or authorization for US-Saudi strikes on Iraqi soil, while the US Embassy in Baghdad restricted staff movement (Source: @SharghDaily/175349, @naya_foriraq/86425).
sections.threat_assessment: The US heavy strikes on Iran and Iran's retaliatory missile fire toward Jordan indicate a significant escalation in the US-Iran direct military confrontation, with US bases in the region now explicitly targeted. The IRGC's claim of destroying F-35s at Al-Azraq, if accurate, represents a major degradation of coalition air capability in the theater. Israel's destruction of Hezbollah's Beaufort Ridge tunnel system and continued strikes in southern Lebanon demonstrate ongoing multi-front operational tempo. The advancing Israel-Hamas disarmament agreement, while a diplomatic development, does not reduce the immediate kinetic threat level given continued Hamas weapons storage and the 6-to-8-month implementation timeline.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are responding to the escalation through multiple channels: the UK has offered to participate in a military mission to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while France has highlighted the global economic impact of any closure. Pakistan has facilitated the safe passage of Qatari LNG through the strait, and Egypt is mediating the Israel-Hamas ceasefire negotiations while disputing Western attribution of the Damietta tanker attack to Iran. Iraq has publicly denied any involvement in or prior knowledge of US-Saudi strikes on its territory, and the UN has issued warnings about worsening humanitarian conditions across West Asia.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of US strikes on Iran, Iranian missile fire toward Jordan, and IDF operations in Lebanon suggests a coordinated regional escalation rather than isolated incidents. The timing of the Beaufort Ridge tunnel demolition, postponed from an earlier date due to the ceasefire and executed only after Hezbollah's drone attack on a bulldozer, indicates Israel is using ceasefire violations as operational triggers. The Givati Brigade revolt at Shachar 10 and the disciplinary measures for absent soldiers suggest potential morale and command-and-control strain within Israeli ground forces. The rapid progression of the Israel-Hamas disarmament agreement toward an Egyptian signing ceremony warrants close monitoring of implementation timelines and compliance mechanisms.
